entities.summary: Gerald Edward Sikorski is an American politician, lobbyist, and lawyer from Minnesota. A member of the Democratic-Farmer-Labor Party, he served five terms as the U.S. Representative for Minnesota's 6th congressional district, from 1983 to 1993.
